column4: cleat#3774: all five call testDB(t) (engine/fault_test.go), which opens a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) -- they skip on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone, and sensitive-payload encryption is PostgreSQL-only (--encrypt-sensitive-payloads refuses every other --driver), so they have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all five skip here. Measured by name, with one non-PostgreSQL DSN set at a time: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH GOCACHE=<cache> GOPATH=<gopath> CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL=<dsn> go test ./engine/ -run '^Test(CompactionStateHoldsNoSensitivePlaintextWhenPayloadsAreSealed|TheSameSearchFindsTheMarkersWhenPayloadsAreNotSealed|ASealedCompactionStateReplaysTheSameHistory|APlaintextCompactionStateStillReadsWhenPayloadsAreSealed|ASealedCompactionStateThatCannotBeOpenedIsAnErrorNotAnEmptyState)$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these five, and the same with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL; with CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set none skip.

cleat#3774: all five call testDB(t) (engine/fault_test.go), which opens a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) -- they skip on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone, and sensitive-payload encryption is PostgreSQL-only (--encrypt-sensitive-payloads refuses every other --driver), so they have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all five skip here. Measured by name, with one non-PostgreSQL DSN set at a time: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH GOCACHE=<cache> GOPATH=<gopath> CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL=<dsn> go test ./engine/ -run '^Test(CompactionStateHoldsNoSensitivePlaintextWhenPayloadsAreSealed|TheSameSearchFindsTheMarkersWhenPayloadsAreNotSealed|ASealedCompactionStateReplaysTheSameHistory|APlaintextCompactionStateStillReadsWhenPayloadsAreSealed|ASealedCompactionStateThatCannotBeOpenedIsAnErrorNotAnEmptyState)$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these five, and the same with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL; with CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set none skip.
